verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an official CLI that installs via npm, logs in, and creates projects. It also covers syncing data models and code, deploying resources, and ejecting apps, and its docs tie it to AI coding agents (code-defined backend, Base44 skills). A probe independently confirms the CLI docs exist. missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Base44 CLI is a command-line tool for building and managing Base44 apps from your terminal.
npm install -g base44@latest # Install the CLI base44 login # Authenticate base44 create # Create a project
Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
Your entire backend is defined in code and configuration files, making it easy for AI coding agents to build and manage your project.
